opportunities.title: Preservation and Conservation Grants – Historic Buildings and Structures

amount.raw: Generally, £1,000 to £30,000 (average approx. £15,000). Sometimes larger sums are considered.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, organisations with exempt charitable status, recognised public bodies, Community Benefit Societies, and Community Interest Companies limited by guarantee. Project must be UK based, not complete, and focus on a listed building or structure.
opportunities.summary: Grants for the preservation and repair of listed historic buildings, structures and architectural features, with special consideration for sustainable conservation and re-use of historic buildings at risk and of outstanding importance. Covers project costs, staff costs, fees, internships, initial exploratory work and capital costs. Stage one applications considered on a rolling basis; stage two applications over £5,000 considered quarterly at Board meetings.

opportunities.title: Preservation and Conservation Grants – Places of Worship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Anglican churches must apply via the ChurchCare conservation grants scheme (part-funded by the Trust); all other denominations, faiths and cathedrals may apply directly. Funds conservation of historic interiors and historic objects in places of worship open for regular worship.
opportunities.summary: Grants for the conservation of historic interiors and historic objects in places of worship open for regular worship, including bells, books and manuscripts, clocks, decorative plasterwork, metalwork and church plate, monuments, organs, paintings, stained glass, textiles, timberwork, wall paintings and historic structures in churchyards, plus commissioning of conservation reports. Stage one considered on a rolling basis; stage two over £5,000 considered quarterly.

opportunities.title: Preservation and Conservation Grants – Conservation of Cultural Heritage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, organisations with exempt charitable status, recognised public bodies, Community Benefit Societies, and Community Interest Companies limited by guarantee. Applicants must not be eligible for the AIM and NMCT grant schemes. Project must be UK based and not complete.
opportunities.summary: Grants for the conservation of culturally and historically significant collections and objects, including works of art, books, significant ephemera, artefacts and archives. Covers project costs, staff costs, fees, paid internships, initial exploratory work and conservation costs. Conservation must be carried out by an accredited conservator. Stage one considered on a rolling basis; stage two over £5,000 considered quarterly.

opportunities.title: Archives Revealed
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, organisations with exempt charitable status, and recognised public bodies. Project must be UK based and not complete.
opportunities.summary: A partnership funding programme between The National Archives, The National Lottery Heritage Fund, the Pilgrim Trust and the Wolfson Foundation, dedicated to cataloguing and unlocking archival collections so that significant archive collections across the UK are made accessible to the public. Applications are made via the National Archives website.
